verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a database product, since databases can ship scheduled tasks such as periodic maintenance or ingestion jobs. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any recurring-job, cron, or workflow-scheduling capability in Milvus. The docs cover search, filtering, multi-tenancy, RBAC, deployment modes and an MCP server, none of which is a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
